newsitem.title: JAPAN: Namco profits seen soaring 30% yr/yr in 96/97-Jiji.
newsitem.headline: Namco profits seen soaring 30% yr/yr in 96/97-Jiji.

text.p: Game equipment maker Namco Ltd is expected to see its parent current profit hit a record 11 billion yen in the 1996/97 year, up 30 percent from the previous year, Jiji news agency said on Thursday.
Namco"s sales are likely to reach 103 billion yen in the year ending March 31, due to robust sales of its game software, Jiji said.
A Namco spokesman, however, said on Thursday that the company maintains its forecast of 100 billion yen in sales and 10 billion yen in parent current profit for the current business year.
He said that sales of its home-use game titles have been more robust than initial expectations.

Domestic shipments of Namco"s "Rage Racer" game software have reached one million units since its launch in December 1996, he said. The company had initially expected shipments to total 500,000 units.
